note: Campground on SD-109 north of Big Stone City, near Big Stone Lake and a public boat launch. Each site has a picnic table and fire ring; there is a playground and a rental cabin. --Claude
summary: Operator site + claimed RoverPass listing read: 40 full-hookup sites (30/50 A, back-in and pull-through to 65 ft), showers, laundry, dump; $35-40 a night online, weekly/monthly rates posted. Passes presence (site + phone; Google 4.6/25) and price (<$50). Mostly nightly. Not waterfront stands.
flags: PRICE: cheapest electric night $35 (30 A), max $40 - under the $50 gate; no gateway needed. RV Life tier 2.
GOOGLE: 4.6 from 25 reviews (passes the 25-review presence test with the phone; above 4.0).

LONG-STAY: weekly and monthly rates are posted ($650/$725 a month) and RoverPass tags 'Extended Stay', but the nightly share is high: 37 of 40 sites were individually bookable by the night on RoverPass for 2026-10-17, and imagery shows ~15 rigs scattered over the loop with no decks, sheds or skirting. Keep, no long-term caveat needed.

DISCOUNTS: the operator posts 'If you are Military/Veteran, Good Sam, or Passport America member, please contact (call or text) us to get your discount' (amount not stated). Stored good_sam false (not an isGsPark designation) and military true are consistent; no group written.
